0.original: <hex:024804F201FC03><hex:024904F201FD03> Quest Sync<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103><hex:02100103>Wezetonyi has a potentially profitable proposal for you.

24.original: Search for anything that can be repurposed.

25.original: Deliver the silver necklace to Wezetonyi.

48.original: Hey, you're the one who was looking for Gulool Ja! Would you say that you're good at finding things, generally speaking?

49.original: In that case, you might do well as a reforger. Our job is to hunt for things that can be repurposed.

50.original: Care to give it a try? Take a look around the ruins to the south, and if you find anything of value, I'll see you duly compensated!

51.original: There are amazing discoveries to be had in the ruins─<hex:021A020203>if<hex:021A020103> you know where to look. Find something useful, and you'll be rewarded for your efforts.

52.original: You dig through the mountain of debris, but find only shapeless planks of wood and nonfunctional electrope.

53.original: You examine the broken streetlamp, but it's already been harvested for parts. Evidently someone has beaten you to the punch.

54.original: As you patiently comb through the enshadowed wreckage, a gleam catches your eye, and you pull up a silver necklace!

55.original: It's unlikely you will find anything more of value here. Return to Wezetonyi and apprise him of your discovery.

57.original: Oh ho! See that engraving? That's the Alexandrian coat of arms. And just look at the shape! How old is this thing?

58.original: It must have belonged to someone who lived in the old city generations ago─in any case, an impressive find, especially for your first try!

59.original: You, my friend, would make an excellent reforger. Here, take this payment for a job well done!
